question: The first medical college in India was established during the period of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord William Bentinck**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first medical college in India, **Calcutta Medical College**, was established during the period of **Lord William Bentinck**.
 
• Calcutta Medical College was established in **1835** and was the first institution in Asia to teach modern medicine.
 
• Lord William Bentinck was the Governor-General of India from **1828 to 1835**.
 
• His tenure is notable for several reforms, including the abolition of Sati and the introduction of English education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Cornwallis** was Governor-General of India from 1786 to 1793 and is known for the **Cornwallis Code and the Permanent Settlement of Bengal**.
 
• **Lord Mayo** served as Viceroy of India from 1869 to 1872 and was **assassinated in the Andaman Islands**.
 
• **Lord Curzon** was Viceroy of India from 1899 to 1905 and is known for the **partition of Bengal in 1905**.
 
• The establishment of Calcutta Medical College marked the beginning of formal medical education in India and paved the way for the development of modern medical practices in the country.
